t: The Hager SEL96T straight BC batten lampholder provides a robust light fitting solution for B22 cap lamps, engineered for dependable electrical installations. Featuring a durable white plastic finish and a raised rounded profile, it ensures a tidy and professional setup suitable for both domestic and commercial environments. This T2 rated lampholder boasts a high 210°C heat resistance, accommodating a wide array of lighting requirements. It incorporates secure screw terminals, accepting up to three 1.5mm² cables, and includes live, neutral, loop-in and earth terminals for comprehensive wiring. An integrated safety mechanism automatically disconnects power when a lamp is removed, enhancing user protection during maintenance. This 3-inch batten lamp holder provides a straight connection for B22 cap fittings, supporting a maximum wattage of 150W and operating on a 240V power supply.
